summary: Self-review: scoped CLI ingestion, Graph HTTP pagination/account checks/cap/expiry, anchored read-only wacli archive snapshots and journal replay, durable retries, source disable/scope isolation, deletion/erasure, real multilingual FastEmbed/Qdrant search, and read-only stdio MCP meet C1-C5 on synthetic sources with real local persistence and inference.
